hassio_confirm.title: Area Events app
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the Area Events integration with the {name} app? Home Assistant found it running and already has everything it needs.

user.title: Area Events app
user.description: Only needed if the app was not found automatically. Enter its address (http:// + the Hostname on its Info tab + :8765) and a token you set in its Configuration tab.

data_description.token: The token option of the app (32 or more characters).

reauth_confirm.title: Token rejected
reauth_confirm.description: The Area Events app rejected the token. Restarting the app lets Home Assistant find it again; otherwise enter the app's token.

error.cannot_connect: The app could not be reached. Check that it is running and that the address is correct.

abort.already_configured: Area Events is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: The app could not be reached. Start it and try again.
abort.invalid_discovery: The app sent incomplete connection details. Restart the app.
